text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* In the northern regions of Douro and Dao, wine production has fallen by 30 to 60 percent this year due to bad weather.

* Pilots of state airline TAP-Air Portugal yesterday delivered a warning to strike to the board. The strike may cause 15 percent of flights in August and September to be cancelled, which will cost the company 3.3 billion escudos in August and may threaten a restructuring plan signed with Brussels.

* Payments of employment and sickness subsidies by the social security department dropped by 9.3 billion escudos in the first six months, compared with the same year-ago period, and contributions by workers and companies were 32.6 billion escudos above the forecast in the 1997 budget, an official source told the paper.
* A consortium involving utility EDP and Petrogas was selected in the first phase of bidding for two power generation projects in Brazil.
* An agreement for the launching of the optical fibre cable Atlantis II is signed today by Portugal Telecom (via Marconi) and Brazilian company Telebras (via Embratel) in Brasilia.
